D.t: Adelita Grijalva leads by 42.5 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 151,996 votes; a one point swing is about 1,789 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +34.9 and D +49.5. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
$469K cash against $12K. Spend it early on persuasion television in the battleground counties and keep a reserve for the last week.
